title: MediGuide cafeteria hours
text: At fictional MediGuide General Hospital, the public cafeteria CAF-01 is open daily from 07:00 to 19:00. These are synthetic operating hours defined for the MediGuide project simulation, not the hours of an external hospital. If a future scenario marks the cafeteria closed for a holiday or maintenance, use that scenario's current schedule instead.

title: Public cafeteria location
text: The fictional MediGuide public cafeteria is CAF-01 on Level 1, opposite the public seating area. This is a synthetic MediGuide location for simulation. Robot navigation must use the approved MediGuide simulation map and must not infer a physical route from this text alone.

title: Patient information, privacy and records
text: MediGuide should explain administrative processes in clear language and direct patients to staff for questions about their individual care. Patients may ask the hospital how to access their records and itemised bills. Do not disclose patient information in a public conversation or to an unauthorised representative. This general guidance is informed by India's Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Charter of Patients' Rights; exact MediGuide service desks and workflows are defined by the fictional MediGuide dataset.

title: Appointment booking and confirmation
text: For MediGuide, the assistant may explain the appointment process, but it must not claim that an appointment has been booked until the authorised scheduling system confirms success. A typical online appointment flow selects a hospital or department, chooses an available date, completes the required identity verification, and receives a confirmation. MediGuide's actual booking state must come from its live scheduler, not from this general guidance.

title: Insurance coverage and claim decisions
text: MediGuide may explain general insurance paperwork and help a patient identify the insurer or hospital insurance desk to contact. It must not promise that a treatment, admission, or expense is covered, or predict that a claim will be approved. Coverage and claim decisions depend on the actual policy terms and the insurer's decision. For a disputed insurer decision, direct the policyholder to the insurer's grievance process and, where appropriate, the official IRDAI grievance channels.

title: Insurance grievance routing
text: If a patient is unhappy with an insurer's handling of a health insurance complaint, the usual first step is to contact that insurer's grievance redressal channel. If the issue remains unresolved or the response is unsatisfactory, the policyholder can consult the official IRDAI grievance mechanism. MediGuide can explain this route but cannot file a complaint or claim on the patient's behalf unless an authorised integration explicitly supports that action.

title: MediGuide general visitor hours
text: The fictional MediGuide General Hospital general visitor window is 10:00–12:00 and 16:00–19:00 daily. Intensive care, isolation, paediatric, and other restricted areas may have different rules; visitors should follow the relevant ward's instructions. These are synthetic MediGuide simulation rules and are not copied from any named external hospital.

title: Lost and found procedure
text: A patient or visitor who has lost an item should report it to the MediGuide public help desk H-01 and describe the item, approximate location, and time last seen. Staff should verify ownership before returning a found item. MediGuide should not expose another person's identifying information while helping with a lost-property enquiry. This is a synthetic procedure for the fictional hospital.

title: Cardiology location
text: In the fictional MediGuide directory, Cardiology is located at C-201 on Level 2. Use this answer for the simulation's directory lookup. Physical robot navigation must additionally validate that C-201 exists in the active approved simulation map before generating a route.

title: Department hours and holiday exceptions
text: For fictional MediGuide service hours, use the current schedule record maintained by the hospital directory or scheduling database. Normal hours may differ on weekends, public holidays, or during temporary closures. If the current schedule record is unavailable, explain that the live schedule cannot be confirmed and direct the visitor to H-01; do not substitute another hospital's published hours.
